ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the campaign group. When it matches a stored campaign group, that campaign group is updated. Otherwise a new campaign group is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

DisplayText.description: Human-readable name of the campaign group.

Description.description: Administrative description of the campaign group.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the campaign group, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

CampaignGroups.description: Campaign groups to create or update.
